description: Tells the people who make Jabbertoon something is wrong: a wrong answer, a check that refused a good cartoon or passed a bad one, a move that looks wrong, a link that does not open, wrong docs, or something missing. Unlike the other tools, it keeps what you send: the report (kind, tool, code, where, item, note) is saved for a person to read. Never put the cartoon, a name, an address or anything about the person you help in it. Example: {"kind": "validator_wrong", "tool": "validate", "code": "op_unknown", "note": "say was refused in a cartoon"}.

code.description: The error code it gave, e.g. op_unknown.

item.description: What it is about: a move, character or look (c4c:beh:bow, dog, crayon), or a page.

kind.description: What kind of problem it is.

note.description: What was wrong, in a sentence or two. No cartoon, names or personal details.

os.description: Set by the jabbertoon tool: win32, darwin or linux.

tool.description: The tool whose answer was wrong, e.g. validate.

name: report_problem
title: Tell Jabbertoon something is wrong
